mapper.select: SELECT b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.brand_logo_url, NVL(LISTAGG(LOWER(c.brand_category_name), ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY c.brand_category_name), '') AS brandCategories FROM Brands b LEFT JOIN Brand_Category bc ON b.brand_id = bc.brand_id LEFT JOIN Category c ON bc.brand_category_id = c.brand_category_id GROUP BY b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.brand_logo_url ORDER BY b.brand_id
SELECT brand_id, brand_name, brand_logo_url, brand_description, brand_origin, brand_mainphoto_url FROM Brands WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}
SELECT brand_id, youtube_video_id, video_thumbnail_url, video_description FROM Brand_Video WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}
SELECT product_id, brand_id, sub_brand_id, product_name, product_volume, product_image_url, product_description FROM Product WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}
SELECT sub_brand_id, brand_id, sub_brand_name, sub_brand_logo_url FROM SubBrand WHERE brand_id = #{brandId}
